## free-tier-llm-landscape

1. Recent changes at Groq: Groq has increased their free tier limit from 100,000 tokens to 250,000 tokens per month. This is a positive development for our system as it allows more requests without incurring costs.
2. Changes at Together: Together has reduced their free tier limit from 5,000 tokens to 3,000 tokens per month. This could potentially impact our agent's performance, so we should verify if there are alternative free providers with higher token limits.
3. OpenRouter updates: OpenRouter has updated their free tier model to a usage-based pricing model, which means our agent might face unexpected costs. We should investigate usage-based pricing models and find a suitable alternative.

## agent-safety-practice

1. Approval tiers: Implementing approval tiers ensures that only authorized users can modify or deploy our autonomous coding agents, preventing accidental or malicious changes.
2. Sandboxing: By isolating our agent within a sandbox environment, we can ensure that its actions are contained and do not interfere with other parts of the system or external services.
